Missing credentials:
  MARVIN_API_TOKEN
  MARVIN_FULL_ACCESS_TOKEN
  MARVIN_SYNC_SERVER
  MARVIN_SYNC_DATABASE
  MARVIN_SYNC_USER
  MARVIN_SYNC_PASSWORD

All six are on one page in Amazing Marvin: Settings > API
(https://app.amazingmarvin.com/pre?api). The two tokens are at the top; the sync values are further down.

Save them once with `marvin auth` — run `marvin auth --help` for the flags. Saved credentials live in /tmp/.marvin/config.json.
